# Axial Skyrmions

- The definition of the relative phase for axial skyrmions, as presented in this paper, differs from previous works such as [3, 12, 7] by an additional $\pi$.
- This distinction arises because the reflection operation here modifies the sign of only one pion field, unlike other studies where all three pion fields undergo a sign change.
- Adopting this specific definition facilitates a more intuitive comparison with monopole systems, which exhibit similar characteristics.
- The Skyrmion and anti-Skyrmion are joined continuously, with their profile functions being zero at a radius $s/2$ from their respective centers, and the fields outside the cores are set to vacuum.
- Beyond simple initial conditions based on ansatz (3.7), more advanced initial conditions were implemented using the rational map ansatz [11], specifically with an axially symmetric charge 'n' map.
